name: Darius Vance
household: Rents a ground-floor flat with two rescued cats; no partner
psychographics: Extremely cost-conscious; every expense must show an immediate ROI. Values flexibility and 'working smarter, not harder'.
current_solutions: Uses a basicWhatsApp Business account for booking appointments and a free invoicing template from Google Docs; no dedicated CRM.
frustration: Tried to upload a new service price list to his WhatsApp Business catalog at 9:00 AM this morning; the image compressed poorly, making the pricing text illegible, so he had to send a follow-up voice note explaining the rates to every client.
decision_style: Compares free apps obsessively; will stick with a free, clunky tool rather than pay €10/month for a 'premium' feature he doesn't understand.
voice: Fast-paced and slang-heavy; uses industry terms like 'furbabies' and 'mobile unit'. Talks quickly, often cutting sentences short when thinking of the next appointment.
